AA_HOTEL.prop: Old hotel called 'Aa Hotel'. 5 floors. Each floor offers a different experience based on the α-subunit composition.
AA_HOTEL.hook: course-wide fixed structure; stands inside the chapter's venue
elements: Floor 1 (α1): Sleep Lobby — giant bed in the entrance
Floor 2 (α2): Calm Lounge — armchairs and tea
Floor 3 (α3): Group-therapy Room — circle of chairs
Floor 5 (α5): Memory Penthouse — secure vault
Hotel Manager = GABA itself (holds master key)
Green CHLORINE SOLDIERS rushing INTO neurons = Cl⁻ influx → hyperpolarization → inhibition
Barbed-wire fence around hotel = Phenobarbital
Bayit-B small synagogue next door = GABA-B (metabotropic, Baclofen prays there)

ALPHA_WOLF_PACK.cue: Alpha wolf pack in a snowy forest
ALPHA_WOLF_PACK.prop: Snowy pine forest. A wolf pack on the hunt. Some lone alphas charge forward, others stay behind on radio. Each wolf wears a numbered tag.
ALPHA_WOLF_PACK.hook: course-wide fixed structure; stands inside the chapter's venue
elements: Lone alpha wolf (#1) = α1 receptor — true alpha hunts, post-synaptic action
Two wolves (one '#2' tag) = α2 receptor — #2 wolf pretends but is actually autoreceptor, calling pack back
Tranquilizer dart from a hunter = α1 blockade (Prazosin, antipsychotic α1 side effect)

ASPARAGUS_VIP_DOOR.prop: Heavy iron door labeled 'NMDA'. Outside: chalk-white Ca²⁺ guests with '2+' badges wait in line. The lock has a horseshoe MAGNET (Mg²⁺) wedged in it. Above the door: a neon sign that flickers when depolarized.
ASPARAGUS_VIP_DOOR.hook: course-wide fixed structure; stands inside the chapter's venue
elements: Mr. Asparagus (Mexican, methyl-mustache CH₃) = NMDA agonist itself (N-methyl-D-Aspartate)
G-shaped gray pebble at his feet = Glycine co-agonist
Horseshoe magnet in lock = Mg²⁺ block
Chalk-white guests with '2+' badges in line = Ca²⁺ entering
Neon sign flickering = depolarization (releases the magnet plug)

BEETHOVEN_ORCHESTRA.prop: Concert hall. Beethoven (white wig, intense face) conducts. Different batons numbered for each symphony. Orchestra has heart-drums section (β1) and wind/brass section (β2).
BEETHOVEN_ORCHESTRA.hook: course-wide fixed structure; stands inside the chapter's venue
elements: Beethoven with '#1' baton + heart-drums section = β1 (heart)
Beethoven with '#2' baton + winds/brass = β2 (lungs)
A fishing NET hangs by the stage door = NET transporter; Beethoven catches stray notes (NE) and returns them

BUS_LINE_1A.prop: Old wooden bus-stop booth. Big sign: '1A'. A frantic rabbit sits trembling on the bench (= anxiety patient awaiting anxiolysis).
BUS_LINE_1A.hook: course-wide fixed structure; stands inside the chapter's venue
elements: Different buses arriving = different 1A partial agonists (Buspirone bus, Vilazodone bus, etc.)
Late bus = autoreceptor delay-of-onset for SSRIs (4-6 weeks)

CIGARETTE_THEATER.prop: Dim theater with cigarettes as branded characters on stage. Smoke curls. A wooden match (Acetylcholine = אצית) ignites scenes.
CIGARETTE_THEATER.hook: course-wide fixed structure; stands inside the chapter's venue
elements: Cigarette brand '42' = nAChR α4β2 (Hitchhiker's Guide answer — 4+2)
Old wise grandpa with 'Lucky 7' cigarette = nAChR α7 (cognition + schizophrenia hypothesis)
Backstage stagehand cigarettes = NMJ-type (α1β1γδ)
Wooden match (אצית) struck = Acetylcholine the agonist
Half-smoked cigarette in a smoker's hand = Varenicline partial agonism

CONVENIENCE_STORE_7.prop: Glowing neon-sign 7-Eleven at midnight. Clock shows 7 AM/PM. Night-clerk on duty.
CONVENIENCE_STORE_7.hook: course-wide fixed structure; stands inside the chapter's venue
elements: Night-clerk turning off neon = Lurasidone blocking 5-HT7

DAIRY_FARM.prop: A green farm on a hill. Each animal produces a different opioid-receptor effect. Hay bales, milk pails, and a Delta-Airlines plane droning overhead.
DAIRY_FARM.hook: course-wide fixed structure; stands inside the chapter's venue
elements: Mooing cow ('MOO') = μ-opioid receptor
Grumpy goat with 'K' tag, kicking = κ-opioid receptor (dysphoria)
Delta-Airlines plane (triangular logo) overhead = δ-opioid receptor (less clinical)
Peaceful endogenous farmer = endorphins
Pails labeled: Analgesia / Euphoria / Constipation / Resp. Depression / Miosis = the spectrum of μ-effects

DOPA_MINE.prop: A working coal mine. Sign at entrance: 'DOPA-MINE Co.'. Inside: 4 sections labeled by pathway — Mesolimbic (heart-shaped chamber), Mesocortical (think-bubble chamber), Nigrostriatal (motor gear chamber), Tuberoinfundibular (milk-pump chamber).
DOPA_MINE.hook: course-wide fixed structure; stands inside the chapter's venue
elements: Vertical elevators going UP = D1-family receptors (Gs/excitatory)
Red barriers/locks blocking flow = D2-family receptors (Gi/inhibitory)
Coal carts = vesicular dopamine release
Newspaper PYRAMID hats labeled 'EXTRA' near nigrostriatal section = EPS
Milk pump at tuberoinfundibular section = prolactin

ER_GUARD_POST.prop: Doorway labeled 'ER'. A sentry guard with 'S-1' badge stands at attention, escorting misfolded proteins.
ER_GUARD_POST.hook: course-wide fixed structure; stands inside the chapter's venue
elements: Guard with 'S-1' badge = sigma-1 chaperone protein
Misfolded proteins arriving in stress = clients of the chaperone
Fluvoxamine + Dextromethorphan visits = drug agonists at σ1

H_HOUSE.prop: A literal H-shaped house. Each floor is a different histamine receptor subtype.
H_HOUSE.hook: course-wide fixed structure; stands inside the chapter's venue
elements: Floor 1 (Living Room) — snoozing couch resident = H1 (sedation/allergy/weight)
Floor 2 (Kitchen) — leaking 'H2O' pots of stomach acid = H2 (gastric)
Floor 3 (Study) — autoreceptor professor dozing on his own desk = H3 (CNS auto, cognition)
Floor 4 (Rooftop) — immune-cell pigeons circling = H4 (immune)

LOCUS_COERULEUS_BLUEPOST.prop: A literal BLUE police box (locus = spot, coeruleus = blue) at the back of the brainstem. Every emergency call goes through it.
LOCUS_COERULEUS_BLUEPOST.hook: course-wide fixed structure; stands inside the chapter's venue

Phone lines fanning out = NE projections everywhere
Panic-button red light = hyperactive LC in panic/PTSD/withdrawal
Prazosin curtain = α1 blockade calming the dispatch noise (PTSD nightmares)

MEYNERT_MYNAH.prop: A wise old MYNAH bird perched in the basal forebrain. It mimics what it hears (cortical ACh = memory).
MEYNERT_MYNAH.hook: course-wide fixed structure; stands inside the chapter's venue
elements: Mynah bird = basal nucleus of Meynert (phonetic)
Bird whispers memorize cortex = cholinergic projections for memory
Bird dies = Alzheimer's pathology (skipped per user, but explains baseline)

RAPHE_TAPESTRY.prop: A narrow Persian-rug weaving workshop running down the brainstem midline. Weavers spin serotonin-yarn into rugs that get shipped EVERYWHERE.
RAPHE_TAPESTRY.hook: course-wide fixed structure; stands inside the chapter's venue

Shipping crates labeled cortex/limbic/hypothalamus = projections everywhere
Old loom that won't start for 4-6 weeks = SSRI delay-of-onset (autoreceptor downregulation)

TAROT_2A.prop: Dim Victorian parlor. Round table with TWO Ace tarot cards. Tie-dye hippie reader. Walls swirl with psychedelic colors. Adjacent rooms: KITCHEN (5-HT2C), WATER-GATE ROOM (5-HT3), LIBRARY (5-HT6).

TUBEROMAMMILLARY_DAIRY.prop: A dairy section in the hypothalamus (mammillary = mammary). Cows pump out histamine to keep the brain awake.
TUBEROMAMMILLARY_DAIRY.hook: course-wide fixed structure; stands inside the chapter's venue

WONDERLAND_TEAPARTY.prop: Iconic Wonderland tea party. Each character maps to one muscarinic receptor by NUMBER + FUNCTION. The whole tableau goes haywire under anticholinergic blockade.
WONDERLAND_TEAPARTY.hook: course-wide fixed structure; stands inside the chapter's venue
elements: White Rabbit with '1 O'Clock' pocket watch = M1 (CNS, memory of time)
Queen of Hearts holding TWO '2-of-Hearts' cards = M2 (heart)
Mad Hatter with 3 dripping teacups (saliva/tears/sweat) = M3 (glands)
Tweedledee & Tweedledum at the corners = M4 / M5 (less clinical)
Anticholinergic toxicity = whole scene gone wild: Mad Hatter mad, Red Queen flushed, March Hare hot, teacups bone-dry, Cheshire Cat invisible (pupils dilated)
